purpose: Prospectively freeze the independent synthetic confirmation design for the fixed EOG v0.2 structural ensemble before any confirmation outcome is computed.

selected_candidate.reason: Only alpha=0.125 satisfied mean null safety, positive mean log-loss gain in every structural regime, and the predeclared +0.05 maximum development-seed harm cap. It also beat the frozen single-cumulative-path comparator in mean log loss in all four structural regimes.

primary_metric: mean Bernoulli log loss over untouched target rows within regime, averaged equally across confirmation seeds
secondary_metrics: worst-seed log-loss harm relative to environmental support

candidate_model.name: fixed probability-gate plus cross-fitted-stack EOG structural ensemble
candidate_model.probability_gate: training-fitted lambda in D = H * ((1-lambda) + lambda*M_EOG)
candidate_model.stack: deterministic L2 logistic f(H, M_EOG, H*M_EOG) fitted on inner out-of-fold H/M; nonstructural stack collapses to H
candidate_model.unlabelled_landscape_nodes: may act as neutral intermediate nodes but never as sources

pending_before_execution: pass source-blob/seed/gate validation from the frozen confirmation runner
pass package regression checks with the final ensemble and confirmation runner
add a separate explicit execution authorization that hard-matches this contract Git blob
scientific_boundary: Synthetic confirmation evaluates predictive support under declared source-conditioned generators. It does not establish realized movement, colonisation probability, latent occupancy, or universal empirical superiority over dynamic, mechanistic, circuit-theory, or other process/connectivity models.
